ClipTooShort.description: The provider makes a `resolution` clip only `seconds` long.
ClipTooShort.title: ClipTooShort

CloudLaunch.description:
The step's machine is a cloud `instance` launched in `region` at `usd_per_hour`: the step ends here and a rerun
once it connects places on it; `dry_run` when no cloud credentials are configured, so nothing was launched.
CloudLaunch.title: CloudLaunch

CriteriaInvalid.description: The step's choice names `name`, which `task` models do not offer (`reason`).
CriteriaInvalid.title: CriteriaInvalid

CriteriaMiswritten.description: The step's choice writes `name`, a `task` property, as another kind than the one it is (`kind`).
CriteriaMiswritten.title: CriteriaMiswritten

EndpointRefused.description: The server refused a provider's address or answer, for this host's safety.
EndpointRefused.title: EndpointRefused

InputEmpty.description: The step's required input `port` has no value, wired or set.
InputEmpty.title: InputEmpty

InputFault.description: The step's inputs or settings cannot run its model.
InputFault.title: InputFault

InsufficientCredits.description:
The wallet cannot cover `estimate_usd`: a run whose estimate would take the balance below zero, or a step on
Galaius's `provider` key (None: the whole run). `runs_paused`: the last auto top-up failed (the gate then does not charge the card again).
InsufficientCredits.title: InsufficientCredits

JobTimeout.description: A provider job still unfinished after `seconds`: the step stopped waiting for its `what`, the provider may finish it.
JobTimeout.title: JobTimeout

MachineFault.description: A step's machine did not run it (`MachineReason`).
MachineFault.title: MachineFault

MachineUnfit.description:
No connected machine, pooled peer or cloud launch meets the step's `requirement` (and its script `language`):
`cloud` why a cloud launch did not either, when one was tried.
MachineUnfit.title: MachineUnfit

ModelRetired.description: The provider shut the step's model down on `on`: `successor` is the model it names in its place.
ModelRetired.title: ModelRetired

ModelSwitchedOff.description:
A step refused because `model` was switched off on its owner's PC (`switch`: the `models` entry that did it), as
recorded by a galaius before 2026-11-16. No model is switched off any more (owner « no hardcoding / deactivating
models »): nothing produces this fault; it stays so the steps that recorded it still read.
ModelSwitchedOff.title: ModelSwitchedOff

MonthlyCapReached.description: The month already at its limit for `provider`.
MonthlyCapReached.title: MonthlyCapReached

NoKey.description: The organisation holds no key for `provider`: one is added in Connections.
NoKey.title: NoKey

NoModelPasses.description: No `task` model passes the step's choice (`criteria`, as its node states them; None: the choice names none).
NoModelPasses.title: NoModelPasses

NoRunner.description: No runner makes `task` with `provider`'s `model`: the step names a model its provider does not serve for it.
NoRunner.title: NoRunner

NoSpeech.description: A transcription heard no speech in its audio.
NoSpeech.title: NoSpeech

NothingReturned.description:
The model answered without the `what` the step asked for; `filtered`: the provider said its safety filter held it
back (`detail`: the provider's stated reason, verbatim).
NothingReturned.title: NothingReturned

OutputLimit.description:
The model stopped at its output ceiling before it finished: `ceiling` tokens (thinking included) when the step set
it, None when the provider's own default held.
OutputLimit.title: OutputLimit

PaidUseOff.description: Paid use of `provider` was never switched on for the organisation.
PaidUseOff.title: PaidUseOff

PaidUseSpend.description:
What this calendar month has actually cost, against the ceiling — the figure every agent
card, the model picker and the alert show, all reading this one shape.
PaidUseSpend.title: PaidUseSpend

PcFeature.description:
A request kind (or part of one) a PC's runner answers, as its hello names it. A runner names every member of the
galaius-core it ships with, and never one it was released before: the server asks a PC only what it names, adapts
where an older PC can be served another way, and else says that PC is outdated. A hello is read as `PcFeatures`.
Members are only ever added: retiring one is a migration of every run cause naming it.
PcFeature.title: PcFeature

PlatformUnpriced.description: `model` has no price Galaius can bill: it never runs on Galaius's `provider` key, only on the organisation's own.
PlatformUnpriced.title: PlatformUnpriced

PoolBudget.description: A pooled run would bring the workspace's pooled spend this period to `projected_usd`, over its `ceiling_usd`.
PoolBudget.title: PoolBudget

ProviderInvalid.description: The provider answered something that is not the answer its API promises (`detail`: the part it got wrong).
ProviderInvalid.title: ProviderInvalid

ProviderSilent.description: The provider did not answer in time, or its address could not be reached.
ProviderSilent.title: ProviderSilent

ResourceRequirement.description:
What one workflow node needs to run, derived from the model registry / the user's model
record. Every field optional: unset means "no constraint from this axis", never zero — a node
with no declared requirement places on any connected machine, today's behaviour unchanged.
ResourceRequirement.title: ResourceRequirement

ServerFault.description: The server could not finish the run (`ServerReason`).
ServerFault.title: ServerFault

StepTimedOut.description: The step ran past its `seconds`; `waiting` what it still waited on (its `machine` to connect), if anything.
StepTimedOut.title: StepTimedOut

StorageFault.description:
A workspace's file storage did not serve the step (`StorageReason`); `not_granted` names the `grant` its
connection lacks.
StorageFault.title: StorageFault

TokenCounts.description:
Tokens one model call used, or a sum of calls: `input` the prompt tokens neither read from nor written to a cache
(the full input rate), `cache_read` / `cache_write` the cached rest of the prompt (each at its own rate), `output`
the reply, reasoning included (`reasoning` the part of it a vendor names apart). Anthropic reports this shape
natively; OpenAI and Gemini count cached tokens inside their prompt figure: carved out at the edge reading their
response, never counted twice. A figure nothing reported is None, never a synthetic zero.
TokenCounts.title: TokenCounts

TurnCapReached.description:
A turn not sent: its worst case (`worst_usd`) on top of what the month already holds without it (`held_usd`:
spent, and the worst cases of the turns in flight) would cross the limit.
TurnCapReached.title: TurnCapReached

UsageTotals.description: What a period's calls of one provenance used, added up with `+`.
UsageTotals.title: UsageTotals

VendorRefused.description:
The provider refused the call: `vendor_status` its HTTP answer, when it gave one (None: its job reported the
failure itself).
VendorRefused.title: VendorRefused
